issues.title: Account hacking and security breaches
issues.summary: Reviewers report their accounts being hacked, phished, or accessed by unauthorized users who change login details and control their playlists.

issues.title: App fails to open or launch
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app won't open, gets stuck on the splash screen, or freezes at startup.

issues.title: Login failures
issues.summary: Reviewers report being unable to log into their accounts, encountering errors or being told their information is incorrect.

issues.title: Other access and regional restrictions
issues.summary: Reviewers report various access problems including being locked out while traveling, regional restrictions, and smart lock interference.

issues.title: Sign-up and phone/email verification issues
issues.summary: Reviewers report problems creating new accounts, with phone numbers or emails not being accepted during registration.

issues.title: Unwanted or duplicate charges
issues.summary: Reviewers report being charged multiple times, charged after cancelling, or not receiving refunds for payments taken from their accounts.

issues.title: General billing and monetization complaints
issues.summary: Reviewers express frustration with Spotify's money-making practices and issues like missing invoices or unclaimed rewards.

issues.title: Core features locked behind Premium
issues.summary: Reviewers report that basic playback features like skipping, choosing songs, repeating, and lyrics are restricted to paying Premium subscribers.

issues.title: Subscription price too high
issues.summary: Reviewers report that the Premium subscription cost is too expensive or has recently increased.

issues.title: Premium subscription not activating or recognized
issues.summary: Reviewers report paying for Premium but not receiving the subscription benefits, or being unable to cancel or access their plan.

issues.title: Lyrics missing or not displaying
issues.summary: Reviewers report that song lyrics fail to load, are missing, or are out of sync with the music.

issues.title: Songs and content missing from catalog
issues.summary: Reviewers report that specific songs, artists, or genres they want are unavailable or have disappeared from the app.

issues.title: Other content and feature gaps
issues.summary: Reviewers report miscellaneous content issues including missing Wrapped results, local file playback problems, and stream filtering concerns.

issues.title: Poor shuffle and recommendation quality
issues.summary: Reviewers report that shuffle repeats the same small set of songs and that recommended music doesn't match their preferences.

issues.title: Search function not working
issues.summary: Reviewers report that searching for songs, artists, or playlists fails to return results or has stopped working after updates.

issues.title: Downloaded content disappearing
issues.summary: Reviewers report that previously downloaded songs and playlists vanish or need to be re-downloaded unexpectedly.

issues.title: Offline playback not working
issues.summary: Reviewers report that downloaded content won't play without an internet connection despite being saved for offline use.

issues.title: Download feature limitations
issues.summary: Reviewers report that downloading songs requires a Premium subscription and that SD card download options have been removed.

issues.title: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.summary: Reviewers express broad frustration and disappointment with the app's overall quality, especially after recent updates.

issues.title: Poor audio quality
issues.summary: Reviewers report low volume, distorted sound, or audio quality that is subpar compared to other music apps.

issues.title: False offline/no-internet errors
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app incorrectly claims there is no internet connection or that they are offline, blocking playback despite having a working connection.

issues.title: App crashes and freezes during use
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app frequently crashes, freezes, or hangs, often requiring a restart to continue using it.

issues.title: Device and connectivity playback problems
issues.summary: Reviewers report issues with audio not playing through headphones, Bluetooth devices, or other connected hardware like Android Auto.

issues.title: Music won't play
issues.summary: Reviewers report that the app simply fails to play songs at all, often after an update.

issues.title: Excessive battery, data, and storage use
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app consumes excessive RAM, battery, data, and storage, and runs persistently in the background.

issues.title: Playback randomly stops or fails to start
issues.summary: Reviewers report that songs stop playing unexpectedly, fail to start, or that the app closes mid-playback.

issues.title: Difficulty reaching customer support
issues.summary: Reviewers report trouble contacting Spotify for help with account and subscription issues.

issues.title: Lack of live customer support
issues.summary: Reviewers report there is no way to speak with a live person for support and that contacting Spotify for help is nearly impossible.

issues.title: Excessive and frequent ads
issues.summary: Reviewers report encountering too many ads, including ads appearing after every song or even for paying Premium subscribers.

issues.title: Playback controls not working as expected
issues.summary: Reviewers report that features like repeat, shuffle, and search buttons are missing, broken, or behave inconsistently.

issues.title: Disliked app redesign and interface changes
issues.summary: Reviewers report that recent UI updates removed familiar features and made the app harder and less pleasant to use.

issues.title: Playlist and library management problems
issues.summary: Reviewers report trouble accessing liked songs, editing or merging playlists, and managing their music queue after updates.

issues.title: Miscellaneous usability complaints
issues.summary: Reviewers report assorted issues including broken links, missing sharing options, lack of parental controls, and disappearing features.
